note: The concept of almost perfect numbers appears in Richard Guy's 'Unsolved Problems in Number Theory' (1981) and Masao Kishore's research papers (1978, 1981), but no source found explicitly dates when the question about non-power-of-2 almost perfect numbers was first posed. The problem seems to have evolved gradually from the study of perfect numbers without a single clear origination point.
